name: tabbed_diagram
title: How a wing makes lift
use_for: An explanation with several views of one thing: tabs, a diagram, a slider that changes it.

page.html:
How a wing makes lift

Air is pushed down; the wing is pushed up.

Air meeting the curved top of the wing is bent downward. By Newton's third law the wing is pushed the other way: that push is lift.

The air moving over the top is faster, and faster air has lower pressure. Higher pressure underneath and lower pressure on top add up to an upward force.
